Class TextureSurface

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core

Represents a renderable texture surface that allows drawing operations onto an off-screen texture.

Remarks

The texture is created with a fixed size and cannot be resized after creation. You must manually unload the texture using Unload() to free resources. Use BeginDraw() and EndDraw() to perform drawing operations on the texture.
